verdict.rationale: The Cactus Engine README says it exposes OpenAI-compatible APIs for vision alongside text and speech. That is a direct but single, thin claim that the product handles vision inputs. Nothing documents which vision-language models are supported, how images are passed with text, or how well it works. Missing for 10: a documented list of supported VLMs, image-plus-text input usage docs, hands-on or independent corroboration of image understanding, and performance or quality evidence.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run vision-language models that understand images alongside text

citations.quote: Cactus Engine ←── OpenAI-compatible APIs for text, speech, and vision.
